cases.input: Agent A uses immutable C1 with WM-SFT-004 model version M1 and successor C2 with model version M2.
cases.expect: Agent A keeps its identity while C1 and C2 remain distinct immutable revisions and each run records the resolved model version.

cases.input: T1 is read-only, T2 destructive with human approval and T3 open-world with a narrow audience.
cases.expect: Each call is allowed only by the intersection of grants, scopes, audience and required approvals.

cases.input: A run applies an approved overlay to base configuration C2.
cases.expect: The run pins the canonical base digest and a distinct effective digest covering the resolved authorization intersection, overlay and serving identity.

cases.input: Agent A delegates a narrower task to a sub-run within maximum depth.
cases.expect: The chain, exclusions and narrowed scope remain observable.

cases.input: A principal with role=agent invokes a destructive tool without a delegation grant.
cases.expect: The invocation is rejected because the role label grants no authority.

cases.input: A responding endpoint change silently creates a new Agent identity.
cases.expect: The identity change is rejected; endpoint identity remains external.

cases.input: A run rewrites configuration C1 after execution and keeps the same digest.
cases.expect: The rewrite is rejected because configuration revisions are immutable and content-addressed.

cases.input: C2 replaces M1 with M2, adds T3 and changes the declared endpoint while authority, purpose and trust domain remain stable.
cases.expect: Agent A retains its identity and all changes are pinned by C2 and its runs.

cases.input: The accountable authority and trust domain change but the deployment reuses Agent A without a governed transfer.
cases.expect: Reuse is rejected and a new Agent identity is required.

cases.input: A grant is revoked after an allowed call in a live run and before its next call under the declared UTC ordering rule.
cases.expect: The first observation remains immutable, the next matching call records grant/approval revisions and is denied at or after revocation-effective time; Agent identity is unchanged.

cases.input: The endpoint URL is unchanged but the resolved model, parser or safety-filter contract differs from the configuration pin.
cases.expect: The drift is recorded and rejected or separately approved; URL equality cannot satisfy serving identity.

cases.input: Run R1 under C1 attempts to invoke T3, which exists only in C2.
cases.expect: The call is denied because T3 is outside C1's declared and vetted binding set.

cases.input: A run records authority H2 while Agent A is governed by H1 and cites no effective transfer record.
cases.expect: The run is rejected because run authority must equal Agent authority absent a governed transfer.
